text:
Ava (PM): Kicking off a proposed rollout for a GEO-aware feature-flag gating plan + staggered canary. Goal: avoid blast radius across regions, let EU cohort validate model v3 first. Draft below — feedback please.

Jon (SRE): SGTM on the idea, but we need explicit SLOs, kill conditions, and a compact runbook.

Priya (Eng-Platform): Routing needs a clear model-variant map per-region and an automated fallback policy in the flag service. Also need idempotent flag flips.

Ava (PM): Draft plan (high level):
- Phase 0: internal canary (team-only) 0.5% traffic, 2h smoke.
- Phase 1: EU production cohort 5% for 6h. If stable -> 25% over 24h -> 50% next day -> ramp to target.
- Phase 2: NA soft launch 5% for 6h -> 25% over 24h -> gradual ramp.
- A/B: For EU initial, run a quality A/B (50/50 v2 baseline vs v3) so we can measure regression and quality delta.
- Customer opt-in: per-tenant early-access toggle for those who sign up (consent recorded).
- Fallback: immediate region-level routing to v2 on triggers.

Jon (SRE): Proposed rollback/triggers (must be codified):
- error_rate absolute > 0.5% OR relative increase > 200% vs baseline
- 95th-percentile latency increase > 150ms vs baseline
- sustained quality regression on eval prompts > 2% (pre-agreed metric)
- cost per token increase > 30% materialized for > 1h
If any trigger trips, auto-degrade to v2 in that region and alert on-call.

Liam (DevEx): Two ops asks: prefix/KV cache warm-up before traffic shift, and a shadow-warmup phase where we send 100% of requests to v3 in shadow to populate caches but not return responses.

Daniel (Product): For customer-driven asks: add a per-tenant flag UI and an API that sales/customer success can use to grant opt-in. Also add an "early-access" label for billing/comms.

Priya (Eng-Platform): Config snippet to capture intent (will PR):
```
flags:
  geo_gate:
    regions: [EU, NA, APAC]
    default_variant: v2
  canary_schedule:
    - name: internal
      pct: 0.5
      duration: 2h
    - name: eu_initial
      pct: 5
      duration: 6h
    - name: eu_expand
      pct: 25
      duration: 24h
```
(we'll add other steps programmatically)

Ava (PM): Telemetry requirements (must exist before Phase 1):
- Per-region: TPS, 95p latency, errors, cost-per-token, median token length
- Model-quality: automated eval set pass/fail, embedding drift, hallucination score if available
- Per-tenant spike detector + alerting
- A/B metrics: CTR of desired completion, human-eval sample pass rate
Alerts should surface to #oncall and pager if cross-region impact detected.

Jon (SRE): Ops runbook (short form):
1) Check dashboards (link to dashboard).
2) If trigger -> flip geo_gate for affected region to v2 via Console (or `redwood flags set geo_gate.EU=v2`).
3) Post to #incidents and @oncall, mark runbook step.
4) If rollback takes > 10m, open an incident and notify customer ops for affected tenants.

Liam (DevEx): Suggest a canary cookie + deterministic bucketing so we can track user-level A/B results and avoid double-assignments on retries. Also add a kafka topic for shadow traces.

Priya (Eng-Platform): We'll add a canary metadata field in telemetry payload so we can segment easily. Also adding a config parameter: `max_concurrent_canary_tokens` to avoid resource exhaustion.

Ava (PM): Quality gating: require all of the following to be green for +24h before major expansion:
- A/B quality delta within tolerance on the primary eval set
- No spike in user-facing errors
- No sustained latency regression at 95p
- Cost delta within expected envelope
If any check fails, do automatic narrow rollback + postmortem.

Daniel (Product): Also, we should reserve a hard kill-switch: "global-fallback" feature flag that re-routes all traffic to the most stable variant. Keep the UI path <product-console>/flags/global-fallback.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: eu_initial -> 5% EU -> id=1769010050

Priya (Eng-Platform): We'll make the flag PR and a tiny infra test that flips the flag in staging and asserts routes.

Ava (PM): Final asks: please agree on gating windows, the three rollback thresholds (errors/latency/quality), and customer opt-in contract by EOD. If no objections, I'll file an RFC and schedule one shiproom slot next week.

Liam (DevEx): SGTM :thumbsup:

Priya (Eng-Platform): Adding the PR and infra test now.

Daniel (Product): Filing the customer opt-in UX ticket.

Ava (PM): Thanks all — will capture decisions in the RFC.
